pr_title: fix(core): host directive validation not picking up duplicate directives on component node

Fixes #52072.

issue_context.title: Unexposed input of hostDirective hide input of directive on host element
comments: You have to explicitly expose the inputs from the host directive, e.g. `hostDirectives: [{directive: TestDirective, inputs: ['appTest']}]`.

I looked into it a bit and I think it's a problem in our validation. We have a check to prevent the same directive from being applied twice to the same element, but it only worked with directives, not with components.

I've sent out a fix at #52073, but it's worth noting that it only fixes our validation. What the example above is trying to do isn't allowed, because a directive isn't allowed to match on an element more than once.

It makes sense to forbid it. Both directive instance could not know each other. And the Host component could not inject the "outside" instance.

The work around of "cloning" the directive is not that messy and solve the problem above.

Thanks for the lightning fast response and fix. Really appreciate Angular team's work !
